meta.title: The Canteen Menu
meta.textType: functional: a canteen menu with pictures and prices

paragraphs: It is twelve o'clock in the school canteen. Lily, Mia, and Leo stand at the menu board. The room is busy, and it smells good. A few children stand in line behind them. The board has a picture and a price for each meal. Chicken and rice is thirty baht. Noodle soup is thirty baht, too. Fried egg and rice is twenty-five baht.

Fruit salad is fifteen baht. Strawberry yoghurt is fifteen baht, too. Orange juice is ten baht. Water is cheap, but chicken and rice is expensive. Water is only five baht. Leo is hungry, so he reads the board slowly. "The noodle soup is popular," says Leo. "It is delicious, but it is hot."

"What do you want, Lily?" asks Mia. "I like strawberries, so I choose the yoghurt," says Lily. "Do you like eggs, Leo?" asks Mia. "No, I don't, but I like chicken," says Leo. "Then you could have the chicken and rice," says Mia. Mia says, "I choose the fruit salad." Each child chooses one meal.

Lily pays fifteen baht for the yoghurt. Mia pays fifteen baht for the fruit salad. Leo pays thirty baht for the chicken and rice. The three children sit at a table. Lily adds a little sugar to her yoghurt. Leo likes chicken with a little pepper. "Shall we taste the fruit salad?" asks Mia. She gives Lily a spoon. "It tastes good!" says Lily. Mia eats her fruit salad, and Lily eats her yoghurt. Leo eats his chicken and rice. Lunch is a good time for friends. What do you choose for lunch? How much is it?
text.summary: Lily, Mia, and Leo read the menu board in the school canteen. Each child chooses a lunch, and they talk about likes and prices.
